paragraphs.text: He needs nothing done for him, yet helps all three worlds alone. All crave him; he craves nil, matted hair and all. Good folk sow love in him that fruits without end, though his own dazzle makes finders drowsy.

He alone freely does amid every deed, and none but his arm or his kindness hauls the triple worlds out of their triple tug. Vice aimed at him flips to virtue; clutching at him turns clutching holy. Thinking on him ennobles grub and godhead alike for release. Starts, middles, ends -- all his along mind's road. Beside his love-nectar no savour shows.

paragraphs.text: Zero needs, sole helper of three worlds. Everybody wants him; he wants nil, tangles and all. The decent sow devotion in him with infinite yield, though his own glare makes winners sleepy.

Only free agent in the whole worksite, and only his muscle or mercy extracts triple worlds from triple static. Malice pointed at him backfires into merit; thirst for him sanctifies thirst. Dwelling on him wins worm to godhead for out. Alpha, fray, omega -- all his, mind-lane. Next to his love-syrup every flavour charts nowhere.
